title: Linking words: because, while, unless, although
intro: Linking words join two ideas into one sentence. A few keep the normal word order. Most send the verb to the end. Learn which is which, and your sentences can get longer without getting harder.

notes.title: 1. en, maar, want, of, dus: normal order
body: After en, maar, want and of, the second part keeps its normal order: subject, then verb.
After dus you can keep the normal order, or put the verb first: dus we blijven thuis, or dus blijven we thuis.

examples.nl: Ik wil mee, maar ik [heb] geen tijd.
examples.en: I want to come, but I don't have time.
It's raining, so we're staying home.

links.label: Wikibooks Dutch, lesson 11: both kinds of linking words

notes.title: 2. Most other linking words send the verb to the end
body: omdat, doordat, terwijl, totdat, voordat, zodra, als, tenzij, zolang, hoewel, zodat, alsof and dat all start a side sentence. In a side sentence the verb goes to the very end.
If the side sentence comes first, the main sentence starts with its verb. You get verb, comma, verb.

examples.nl: Ik bel je, omdat ik een vraag [heb].
examples.en: I'm calling you because I have a question.
While you cook, I'll set the table.

notes.title: 3. omdat or doordat?
body: Both mean “because”. Omdat gives a reason that someone has: I'm calling because I have a question.
Doordat gives a cause that just happened, with nobody choosing it: the train was late because of a breakdown. In everyday speech, many people use omdat for both.

examples.nl: Ik bel je [omdat] ik een vraag heb.
examples.en: I'm calling you because I have a question.

examples.nl: De trein was laat [doordat] er een storing was.
examples.en: The train was late because there was a breakdown.

notes.title: 4. Time: terwijl, totdat, voordat, zodra
body: terwijl: while. totdat: until. voordat: before. zodra: as soon as. All of them send the verb to the end.

examples.en: We wait until the bell rings.

examples.nl: Poets je tanden [voordat] je naar bed gaat.
examples.en: Brush your teeth before you go to bed.

examples.nl: Ik bel je [zodra] ik thuis ben.
examples.en: I'll call you as soon as I'm home.

notes.title: 5. Conditions: als, tenzij, zolang
body: als: if. tenzij: unless. zolang: as long as. Parents use these all day.

examples.nl: Je krijgt een ijsje [als] je je bord leeg eet.
examples.en: You get an ice cream if you finish your plate.

examples.nl: Er is geen toetje, [tenzij] je je groente opeet.
examples.en: There's no dessert unless you eat your vegetables.

examples.nl: Je mag buiten spelen, [zolang] je in de tuin blijft.
examples.en: You can play outside as long as you stay in the garden.

notes.title: 6. hoewel, zodat, alsof
body: hoewel: although. zodat: so that. alsof: as if.

examples.nl: [Hoewel] het regent, gaan we toch fietsen.
examples.en: Although it's raining, we're cycling anyway.

examples.nl: Ik doe de gordijnen dicht, [zodat] het donker is.
examples.en: I'm closing the curtains so that it's dark.

links.label: Wikibooks Dutch, lesson 11: both kinds of linking words

cards.nl: Het regent, dus we blijven thuis.
cards.en: It's raining, so we're staying home.

cards.nl: Ik wil mee, maar ik heb geen tijd.
cards.en: I want to come, but I don't have time.

cards.nl: Laten we koekjes bakken, want oma komt op bezoek.
cards.en: Let's bake cookies, because Grandma is coming to visit.

cards.nl: Ik bel je omdat ik een vraag heb.
cards.en: I'm calling you because I have a question.
cards.rule: omdat: a reason, with heb at the end.

cards.nl: Ik begrijp voetbal niet, omdat ik het als kind nooit gespeeld heb.
cards.en: I don't understand football, because I never played it as a kid.
cards.rule: omdat sends both verbs to the end: gespeeld heb.

cards.nl: Het was zo druk dat we de hele reis moesten staan.
cards.en: It was so busy that we had to stand the whole trip.
cards.rule: zo … dat: the verbs go to the end.

cards.nl: De trein was laat doordat er een storing was.
cards.en: The train was late because there was a breakdown.

cards.nl: De muziek stopte doordat de stekker eruit viel.
cards.en: The music stopped because the plug fell out.

cards.nl: Terwijl jij kookt, dek ik de tafel.
cards.en: While you cook, I'll set the table.
alts: Ik dek de tafel terwijl jij kookt.
cards.rule: Side sentence first, then verb, comma, verb.

cards.nl: Ik pak de dozen in terwijl jij de inhoud opschrijft.
cards.en: I'll pack the boxes while you write down what's in them.
cards.rule: terwijl: while. The split verb opschrijven stays together at the end.

cards.nl: We wachten totdat de bel gaat.
cards.en: We wait until the bell rings.

cards.nl: Poets je tanden voordat je naar bed gaat.
cards.en: Brush your teeth before you go to bed.

cards.nl: Ik bel je zodra ik thuis ben.
cards.en: I'll call you as soon as I'm home.

cards.nl: Je mag een speeltje kiezen als je je kamer opruimt.
cards.en: You can pick a toy if you tidy your room.
cards.rule: als: if. opruimen stays together at the end.

cards.nl: Er is geen toetje, tenzij je je groente opeet.
cards.en: There's no dessert unless you eat your vegetables.

cards.nl: Ik eet nooit vis, tenzij ik kibbeling op de markt koop.
cards.en: I never eat fish, unless I buy kibbeling at the market.

cards.nl: Je mag buiten spelen zolang je in de tuin blijft.
cards.en: You can play outside as long as you stay in the garden.

cards.nl: Hoewel het regent, gaan we toch fietsen.
cards.en: Although it's raining, we're cycling anyway.
alts: We gaan toch fietsen, hoewel het regent.
cards.rule: hoewel first, then verb, comma, verb.

cards.nl: Ik doe de gordijnen dicht zodat het donker is.
cards.en: I'm closing the curtains so that it's dark.

cards.nl: Hij doet alsof hij slaapt.
cards.en: He's pretending to be asleep.
cards.rule: alsof: as if. Doen alsof means to pretend.
